newsitem.title: USA: AIG Q3 general insurance premiums up.
newsitem.headline: AIG Q3 general insurance premiums up.

text.p: American International Group Inc, reporting higher third quarter results, said worldwide net premiums written in general insurance rose 9.4 percent in the quarter before the impact of foreign exchange.
After accounting for foreign exchange impact, general insurance worldwide net premiums written rose 6.1 percent.
Domestic net premiums written in general insurance rose 7.1 percent and increased 12.7 percent excluding the risk management business.
Catastrophe losses for the quarter were $22.5 million, compared to $15.1 million a year ago. The combined ratio was 96.45. AIG did not provide the year-ago combined ratio.
The combined ratio indicates whether a company is earning a profit on the business it writes. An underwriting profit occurs when the ratio is below 100 percent.

AIG said worldwide life insurance premium income rose 9.2 percent in the third quarter, to $2.21 billion from $2.03 billion in 1995. Premium income before the impact of foreign exchange rose 15.5 percent.
AIG's worldwide life insurance operations reported third quarter pretax income before realized gains of $328.7 million, up 23.5 percent from $266.1 million a year earlier.
Financial services pre-tax operating income rose 40.3 percent, to $133.9 million from $95.5 million.
Agency and service fee pretax operating income slipped to $12.2 million from $13.9 million.
AIG said its equity in the income of minority-owned insurance operations rose to $26.3 million from $20.1 million.
